produce.prompt_used: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless-looking material texture map for interactive CSS 3D book bindings in LexOpen. Primary request: one square, orthographic, edge-to-edge macro photograph of classic fine-grain bookbinding leather only. Output 1024 x 1024 pixels. Color palette: strictly neutral grayscale, light midgray base, tiny charcoal pores and subtle pale high points; no brown or warm tint. Materials: naturally irregular, very fine dense calfskin grain with microscopic branching creases, understated and refined like a traditional leather-bound law book. Composition: a perfectly flat continuous surface fills all pixels, no perspective, no object edges. Lighting: uniform neutral diffuse illumination across the entire image; retain small-scale surface relief but eliminate large-scale shading. Intended use: repeated texture multiplied over six independently chosen book colors, so keep tonal contrast subtle and luminance consistent edge to edge. Constraints: visually tileable repeating texture, edges blend unobtrusively; no seams, stitching, border, ornament, embossing, titles, lettering, symbols, logos, watermark, objects, books, shelves, room, highlights, directional shadows, vignette, or global gradient. Opaque background.
produce.deviations: Native output 1254x1254 downsampled to requested production size; grayscale intentionally supports six CSS binding colors
produce.implementation_notes: Apply as repeating background-image with multiply over binding background color. Keep book faces, depth, perspective, ornamental rules, typography, focus, and shadows in CSS/HTML. Grain is deliberately neutral and uniform.

produce.prompt_used: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: real walnut wood material texture map for horizontal CSS shelves and shelf back panels in the LexOpen legal library. Primary request: one landscape, orthographic, edge-to-edge close-up photograph of dark walnut wood grain only, 2:1 aspect ratio intended final size 1024 x 512 pixels. Materials: finely finished natural walnut with long flowing horizontal grain, small restrained pores, subtle organic variations; deep chocolate brown with muted warm walnut tones. Composition: a perfectly flat continuous wooden surface fills every pixel, grain runs horizontally left to right, no perspective and no visible board edges or joints. Lighting: perfectly even soft diffuse neutral illumination, matte finish, no large scale light gradient. Constraints: unobtrusively repeatable texture and nearly matching edges, no knots dominating the frame, no planks or seams, no shelves, books, furniture, plants, lamps, objects, hardware, lettering, text, logos, watermark, borders, strong gloss, specular highlights, bevels, directional shadows, vignette, or room scene. Opaque background.
produce.deviations: Native output 1774x887 downsampled to requested production size
produce.implementation_notes: Apply horizontal grain as repeating background-image on shelf panels and ledges. CSS owns shelf geometry, panel depth, edge highlights and local contact shadows.
